simple.meaning: שָׁשָׁא (shâshâʼ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to annihilate.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ezekiel, beginning at Ezekiel 39:2. The surrounding contexts include mountain, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁשָׁא (H8338) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שָׁשָׁא (shâshâʼ) / H8338 is traced through Ezekiel 39:2 with source-language evidence and verse context.
